BackstoryDef.title: House heir
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised as the future of a house, which meant tutors before dawn, drillmasters after, and a father who measured [PAWN_objective] against cousins at every meal. Nobody asked whether [PAWN_pronoun] was happy. The question had never come up in the family.

BackstoryDef.title: Lesser scion
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: A third child of a minor house on a minor moon. [PAWN_nameDef] had the blood and the training and none of the attention, and learned early that a Gold nobody is watching can get away with a great deal.

BackstoryDef.title: Drillmaster's ward
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Orphaned young and handed to the house's weapons master to raise, [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the practice yard rather than the salon. [PAWN_pronoun] can fight better than [PAWN_pronoun] can talk, which among Golds is a handicap and an asset in equal measure.

BackstoryDef.title: Institute graduate
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] went through the Institute and came out the far side alive and unremarkable, which is what happens to most who go in. [PAWN_pronoun] commands competently, governs adequately, and has made peace with the fact that no door will ever go quiet when [PAWN_pronoun] walks through it.

BackstoryDef.title: Peerless
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] won. The scar on [PAWN_possessive] face says so before [PAWN_pronoun] opens [PAWN_possessive] mouth, and every Gold in any room has already done the arithmetic of what that means for their own standing. [PAWN_pronoun] has never had to raise [PAWN_possessive] voice.

BackstoryDef.title: Iron commander
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] believes the old creed: that a Gold who does not bleed beside the Grays has no right to command them. [PAWN_pronoun] sleeps on the floor of [PAWN_possessive] own quarters, eats what the troops eat, and is loathed by the Golds who do neither.

BackstoryDef.title: Pleasure-house Gold
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] inherited an empire and treated it as an allowance. Parties that lasted a season, duels fought by proxy, Pinks by the dozen. The old Golds call [PAWN_objective] a pixie and the word is not kind, but it is accurate.

BackstoryDef.title: Shamed Gold
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] went into the Institute and came out the bottom. The law still calls [PAWN_objective] Gold and so does the mirror, but the posting that followed was on the edge of nowhere, with a title nobody uses and a staff who pity [PAWN_objective]. [PAWN_pronoun] has had years to think about it.

BackstoryDef.title: Ledger child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] could read a balance sheet before [PAWN_pronoun] could read a story. [PAWN_possessive] family dealt in the money that Golds pretend not to think about, and taught [PAWN_objective] that every favour is a loan with the terms left unspoken.

BackstoryDef.title: Counting-house runner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: A poor Silver is still a Silver, and [PAWN_nameDef]'s family was poor. [PAWN_pronoun] ran messages between the houses that mattered, and learned which doors opened for a child with the right eyes and the wrong shoes.

BackstoryDef.title: House factor
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] managed the fortune of a Gold house that could not have told you where its own money was. [PAWN_pronoun] took a percentage, as factors do, and the house never missed it, as houses do not.

BackstoryDef.title: Trade broker
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Helium, ionsteel, bodies - [PAWN_nameDef] brokered whatever was moving and never once asked where it had come from. [PAWN_pronoun] has contacts in three merchant houses and debts in two of them.

BackstoryDef.title: Quiet financier
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Somebody pays for every revolution, and for a while that somebody was [PAWN_nameDef]. [PAWN_pronoun] moved money to people the Society would have hanged and did it from an office with a view of the Society's own banners. [PAWN_pronoun] is not sure anyone has noticed yet.

BackstoryDef.title: Cloister child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in a cloister where the Whites keep their own, learning law and rite and the long silences in between. [PAWN_pronoun] did not meet a child of another Color until [PAWN_pronoun] was twelve, and found the experience unsettling.

BackstoryDef.title: Court observer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parent sat in judgment, and [PAWN_nameDef] sat behind, watching. By ten [PAWN_pronoun] could tell which Gold would lie before the Gold knew it. By fourteen [PAWN_pronoun] had stopped finding it interesting.

BackstoryDef.title: Arbiter
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] ruled on disputes between houses that could have ended in war, and [PAWN_possessive] rulings held because both sides feared the Whites more than each other. [PAWN_pronoun] has never carried a weapon. [PAWN_pronoun] has never needed one.

BackstoryDef.title: Rite-keeper
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Weddings, funerals, the marking of the Peerless - [PAWN_nameDef] presided over all of it, in the same voice, for thirty years. [PAWN_pronoun] knows the words to every ceremony the Society has and believes about half of them.

BackstoryDef.title: Census auditor
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] counted people for the Board. Births against targets, deaths against projections, a column for each Color. [PAWN_pronoun] can tell you the breeding quota of any mine in the system and has stopped noticing that the numbers are people.

BackstoryDef.title: Clerk's apprentice
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to file before [PAWN_pronoun] learned to run. Forms, permits, the proper seals in the proper order - the Society runs on paper and Coppers are raised to be the paper.

BackstoryDef.title: Bureau brat
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Both parents worked for the same ministry, which meant [PAWN_nameDef] grew up under a desk. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how every office in the system actually works, as opposed to how it says it works, and finds the difference funny.

BackstoryDef.title: Ministry official
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] ran a department whose purpose nobody above [PAWN_objective] could name and nobody below [PAWN_objective] could do without. [PAWN_pronoun] stamped, approved, deferred and denied, and the Society kept turning.

BackstoryDef.title: Mine administrator
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the books for a helium mine - quotas, rations, the tally of Reds below. [PAWN_pronoun] never went down the shaft. [PAWN_pronoun] knew exactly how many came back up each year and signed the form that said it was acceptable.

BackstoryDef.title: Customs clerk
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Every crate that crossed a dock crossed [PAWN_nameDef]'s desk first. [PAWN_pronoun] learned what was in them, who wanted it, and precisely how much a signature was worth. [PAWN_pronoun] left the post with savings nobody has asked about.

BackstoryDef.title: Dock-born
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in orbit and did not stand on a planet until [PAWN_pronoun] was nine. The crews raised [PAWN_objective] between shifts; [PAWN_possessive] first toy was a navigation plot and [PAWN_possessive] first word was a heading.

BackstoryDef.title: Pilot academy
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Selected young for the academies, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood in a simulator being told [PAWN_pronoun] was the best in the cohort, then being shown someone better. The result is a pilot who is very good and does not believe it.

BackstoryDef.title: Helmsman
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] flew warships for the Society and never once chose where they went. [PAWN_pronoun] put a Gold's orders into a hull the size of a city and made them true, and was thanked for it about as often as the hull was.

BackstoryDef.title: Hauler pilot
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Freight, not glory. [PAWN_nameDef] ran helium from the mines to the refineries for twenty years, a route so familiar [PAWN_pronoun] could fly it asleep and sometimes did. [PAWN_pronoun] knows every shaft-head and dock on the run by its lights.

BackstoryDef.title: Grounded navigator
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: A Blue without a ship is a strange, unhappy thing, and [PAWN_nameDef] has been one for years. Whatever cost [PAWN_objective] the post is not discussed. [PAWN_pronoun] still looks up at the wrong moments and still calculates burns for ships [PAWN_pronoun] will never fly.

BackstoryDef.title: Physician's child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a clinic that treated every Color and billed them accordingly. [PAWN_pronoun] held clamps at eight and closed a wound at eleven, and has never been squeamish about anything that bleeds.

BackstoryDef.title: Laboratory-raised
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_possessive] parents studied things in jars, and [PAWN_nameDef] was mostly left to study them too. [PAWN_pronoun] learned patience, precision, and that most questions worth asking take a decade to answer.

BackstoryDef.title: House physician
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] kept a Gold house alive: the duelling wounds, the poisonings, the children who were not supposed to exist. [PAWN_pronoun] has seen what the ruling caste looks like under the skin and has never been impressed by it since.

BackstoryDef.title: Mine surgeon
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Posted to a helium mine, [PAWN_nameDef] set bones and sewed burns on Reds for a decade with half the supplies [PAWN_pronoun] requested. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to work fast, work cheap, and to stop asking the Copper upstairs for anything.

BackstoryDef.title: Gene researcher
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] worked on the templates the Colors are bred from - the gene lines, the drift corrections, the quiet adjustments nobody outside the laboratory is told about. [PAWN_pronoun] knows exactly how the castes were made and finds the knowledge heavier every year.

BackstoryDef.title: Terminal child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was given a terminal at four and a system to maintain at nine. [PAWN_possessive] childhood was an unbroken conversation with machines, which answered more reliably than anyone else in the house.

BackstoryDef.title: Cipher pupil
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Raised in a Society signals school, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood breaking codes set by adults who expected [PAWN_objective] to fail. [PAWN_pronoun] did not, and learned to keep [PAWN_possessive] face still while doing it.

BackstoryDef.title: Systems engineer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the networks of a Gold house running, which meant [PAWN_pronoun] read every message the house sent and most of the ones it received. [PAWN_pronoun] has never been asked to use any of it, and has never been sure whether that is trust or oversight.

BackstoryDef.title: War-signals operator
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] served with a legion as its ears and eyes: jamming, tracking, listening to the enemy breathe. [PAWN_pronoun] was armed, trained, and expected to fight if the line broke, which it did twice.

BackstoryDef.title: Blacknet runner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Officially [PAWN_nameDef] maintained archive systems. Unofficially [PAWN_pronoun] moved information the Society would have killed to stop, between people who never met. [PAWN_pronoun] still flinches at an unexpected knock.

BackstoryDef.title: Atelier child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among sculptors and composers who argued about beauty the way other castes argue about money. [PAWN_pronoun] was handed a brush before a spoon and was expected to have an opinion about both.

BackstoryDef.title: Carver's apprentice
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Apprenticed to a Carver at nine, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood watching bodies be remade and learning that flesh is only another medium. [PAWN_pronoun] can draw a nerve from memory and has strong views on the aesthetics of a scar.

BackstoryDef.title: Carver
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] remakes people. Faces, frames, Colors - for a price, and the Society prefers not to ask what [PAWN_pronoun] has made for whom. [PAWN_pronoun] considers [PAWN_possessive] work art and [PAWN_possessive] clients canvases, which they do not always enjoy hearing.

BackstoryDef.title: Court artist
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Golds collect Violets the way they collect everything else. [PAWN_nameDef] was collected: composed for one house, painted for another, and told at every turn how fortunate [PAWN_pronoun] was. [PAWN_pronoun] agreed, in public.

BackstoryDef.title: Gutter poet
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Not every Violet finds a patron. [PAWN_nameDef] wrote for the low Colors instead - songs that were sung in the mines and the barracks and that [PAWN_pronoun] was never paid for. Some of them are banned now. [PAWN_pronoun] is prouder of that than of anything else.

BackstoryDef.title: Workshop child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on a shop floor, passing tools before [PAWN_pronoun] could name them. By ten [PAWN_pronoun] could strip a drill motor; by twelve [PAWN_pronoun] had been burned, cut and crushed enough to have stopped mentioning it.

BackstoryDef.title: Dockyard scrapper
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] ran with the children who stripped wrecks in the orbital yards for whatever the Society had not bothered to salvage. [PAWN_pronoun] can tell good metal from bad by the sound it makes when dropped.

BackstoryDef.title: Fleet mechanic
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] kept warships flying with parts that did not exist and time that had not been allotted. [PAWN_pronoun] has never been thanked by a Gold and has stopped expecting to be. The ships flew. That was the thanks.

BackstoryDef.title: Drill engineer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: The drills that eat rock in the helium mines are [PAWN_nameDef]'s. [PAWN_pronoun] built them, tuned them, and went down the shaft to fix them when they failed, which made [PAWN_objective] one of the few higher Colors a Red crew would speak to.

BackstoryDef.title: Saboteur
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Everything [PAWN_nameDef] knows about building, [PAWN_pronoun] has used to take apart. Fuel lines, lift cables, the clamps that hold a dock together - [PAWN_pronoun] knows where every machine the Society owns is weakest, because [PAWN_pronoun] used to be the one who kept it from breaking there.

BackstoryDef.title: Barracks child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a garrison to two soldiers and raised by the regiment between deployments. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to march before [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read and has never found a civilian house that felt like home.

BackstoryDef.title: Cadet
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Taken into a Society training school at seven, [PAWN_nameDef] was shaped into exactly what the legions needed: steady hands, a short memory for pain, and no questions. [PAWN_pronoun] turned out well. [PAWN_pronoun] is not sure [PAWN_pronoun] turned out at all.

BackstoryDef.title: Legionary
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] stood a wall for the Society. Riots, raids, the occasional war between Gold houses that the Grays died in and the Golds toasted afterwards. [PAWN_pronoun] is good at it, and has long since stopped asking what it is for.

BackstoryDef.title: Lurcher
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] hunted people. Escaped Reds, carved impostors, Golds the Society had quietly decided against - [PAWN_pronoun] found them, and what happened next was not [PAWN_possessive] concern. [PAWN_pronoun] is patient, observant and very hard to lose.

BackstoryDef.title: Mine warden
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] kept order in a helium mine, which meant keeping Reds underground and the lift locked. [PAWN_pronoun] was not cruel by the standards of the post and knows how little that is worth.

BackstoryDef.title: Deserter
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: There was an order, and [PAWN_nameDef] did not carry it out. What the order was, [PAWN_pronoun] does not say. [PAWN_pronoun] walked out of the legion with [PAWN_possessive] rifle and [PAWN_possessive] armour and has been looking over [PAWN_possessive] shoulder ever since.

BackstoryDef.title: Pole-born
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on the ice where the Society keeps the Obsidians, in a tribe that believes the Golds are gods because the Golds arranged for them to. [PAWN_pronoun] killed [PAWN_possessive] first animal at six and [PAWN_possessive] first rival at eleven.

BackstoryDef.title: Taken young
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: The Society came to [PAWN_nameDef]'s tribe when [PAWN_pronoun] was eight and chose the strongest children. [PAWN_pronoun] was carried off to be trained, and has not seen the ice or [PAWN_possessive] family since. [PAWN_pronoun] remembers the cold more clearly than their faces.

BackstoryDef.title: Tribal warrior
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] fought for [PAWN_possessive] tribe and prayed to the Golds between fights. [PAWN_pronoun] has never seen a city. [PAWN_pronoun] has seen a great deal of blood and considers most of it to have been deserved.

BackstoryDef.title: Stained
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Chosen from the tribe and shaped into something more than a warrior, [PAWN_nameDef] serves as the Society's blade and knows nothing else. The marks on [PAWN_possessive] skin are an oath. [PAWN_pronoun] has not yet been given a reason to break it.

BackstoryDef.title: House bodyguard
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] stood behind a Gold for fifteen years and killed whoever came too close. [PAWN_pronoun] learned the house's manners by watching and its secrets by being invisible. Nobody ever thought to lower their voice around the Obsidian.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea raider
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] belongs to no tribe and no house. [PAWN_pronoun] raids whoever is closest and worships nothing, which the Society finds more alarming than any rebellion. [PAWN_pronoun] has taken Gold ships and worn Gold armour and was not struck down for it.

BackstoryDef.title: Freed Obsidian
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Someone showed [PAWN_nameDef] that the gods bleed. [PAWN_pronoun] has not been the same since, and neither has anyone who stood between [PAWN_objective] and the people who lied to [PAWN_possessive] tribe for three hundred years.

BackstoryDef.title: Garden-raised
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in a Garden, where Pinks are taught to please before they are taught to read. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read anyway, in secret, and has never told anyone which books.

BackstoryDef.title: House-born Pink
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Born to a Pink in a Gold household and raised as part of the furniture, [PAWN_nameDef] grew up knowing every secret in the house and the price of repeating any of them. [PAWN_pronoun] is charming because charm was the only thing that was ever safe.

BackstoryDef.title: Companion
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to a Gold house as its companion and spent a decade being exquisite on demand. [PAWN_pronoun] can read a room before the door closes and manage a temper before it breaks, and has rarely been thanked for either.

BackstoryDef.title: House steward
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Too old for the Gardens and too useful to discard, [PAWN_nameDef] ran a Gold household: the staff, the kitchens, the thousand small arrangements that let Golds believe things simply happen. [PAWN_pronoun] is superb at it and has never once been seen to be.

BackstoryDef.title: Listener
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Golds say things in front of Pinks that they would never say in front of people. [PAWN_nameDef] listened, remembered, and passed it on to those who could use it. [PAWN_pronoun] has ended careers with a single sentence and no one has ever suspected the source.

BackstoryDef.title: Kitchen child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up below stairs in a Gold house, peeling and scrubbing from the age [PAWN_pronoun] could hold a knife. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how the people upstairs take their meals and has never once eaten one.

BackstoryDef.title: Field-born
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on an agricultural estate and was working its rows by seven. [PAWN_pronoun] has never been further than the next estate over and does not expect to be. The plants, at least, have never told [PAWN_objective] what [PAWN_pronoun] is.

BackstoryDef.title: House servant
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] cleaned, carried and cooked for a Gold house for most of [PAWN_possessive] life. [PAWN_pronoun] knows which Gold sleeps badly and which one drinks, and has learned to be present without being seen.

BackstoryDef.title: Estate hand
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Sowing, reaping, the animals, the walls - whatever needed hands, [PAWN_nameDef]'s were the ones used. [PAWN_pronoun] can make anything grow and has never owned a single thing [PAWN_pronoun] grew.

BackstoryDef.title: Runaway
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: One night [PAWN_nameDef] put down the tray and walked out of the house, and nobody noticed for three days. [PAWN_pronoun] has been moving ever since, working for whoever asks no questions. Being nobody turns out to be something [PAWN_pronoun] was well trained for.

BackstoryDef.title: Mine-born
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born underground and saw the sky for the first time as an adult, if at all. The mine was the whole world: the clan, the shaft, the pitvipers, the songs. [PAWN_pronoun] was told it was all there was and believed it.

BackstoryDef.title: Scrubber's child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Too small to drill, [PAWN_nameDef] cleaned the machines that did. [PAWN_pronoun] crawled into spaces adults could not reach and came out with the grit of every drill in the shaft under [PAWN_possessive] nails. [PAWN_pronoun] still cannot stand still in a tight space.

BackstoryDef.title: Clan singer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Every clan keeps its songs, and [PAWN_nameDef] was the child who kept them best. [PAWN_pronoun] sang at the burials and the weddings and the long shifts, and learned early that some songs are sung quietly because the wardens are listening.

BackstoryDef.title: Helldiver
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] rode the drill. Helldivers go where the rock is hottest and the gas is thickest, and most of them do not reach thirty. [PAWN_pronoun] is fast, reckless, and better in a hole than anyone born above ground will ever be.

BackstoryDef.title: Drill hand
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] worked the shaft: hauling, bracing, feeding the drills, burying the ones the drills ate. Thirty years of it. [PAWN_pronoun] can read rock the way Coppers read ledgers and has exactly as much to show for it.

BackstoryDef.title: Clan elder
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] outlived the drill, which among Reds is itself a kind of rank. [PAWN_pronoun] settled the clan's quarrels, counted its dead and kept its songs, and dealt with the wardens so nobody younger had to.

BackstoryDef.title: Surface Red
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Not every Red is a miner. [PAWN_nameDef] cleaned the cities the other Colors live in, hauling and scrubbing and sleeping in the dormitories under the streets. [PAWN_pronoun] has seen the sky every day and been told every day that it was not [PAWN_possessive].

BackstoryDef.title: Cell fighter
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] joined the resistance with nothing but anger and was handed a rifle. [PAWN_pronoun] has learned the rest the hard way, in cellars and tunnels and the backs of stolen haulers, and is still alive, which in [PAWN_possessive] line of work counts as seniority.

BackstoryDef.title: Tunnel runner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Messages, weapons, people - [PAWN_nameDef] moved them through places the Society does not map. [PAWN_pronoun] has been chased by Lurchers and lost them, more than once, and would rather not talk about the times it was close.

BackstoryDef.title: Turncoat
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] had a place in the Society and gave it up. The people [PAWN_pronoun] fights beside now do not fully trust [PAWN_objective], and the people [PAWN_pronoun] left would kill [PAWN_objective] on sight. [PAWN_pronoun] has decided that this is what honesty costs.
